stages.objective: Obtain exact public annotated tag and peeled commit; freeze all 64 docker entries and the full monorepo build closure for dev Studio.
mandatory_evidence: Compare Git blob IDs, bytes, modes and sorted inventory with the unchanged original packet. Reject truncated tree, symlinks and checkout conversion.
Classify all 14 Compose documents and five auxiliary YAML files; retain parser diagnostics and exact include/override order.

Resolve dev context relative to its actual Compose project directory; retain apps/studio/Dockerfile, workspace files, lockfile, patches, package source, base image, framework, build target and build arguments. Verify all COPY and package dependencies; five sampled files are not closure.

stages.objective: Produce a new supplemental packet while retaining the original packet and failures.
mandatory_evidence: For all 23 references retain raw immutable index or single manifest, both declared platform manifests, and raw config blobs; hash every descriptor edge and validate config os/architecture.
The new observations cover five references only. Do not fill missing config bytes, missing architecture, source provenance or build-only output with guessed values.
Treat current mutable tag observations as dated observations. Preserve original frozen digests and require explicit drift review before any revision.

Resolve source provenance from authenticated publisher build evidence or a separately declared reproducible public build with full material closure. OCI labels alone are self-attested. Record unsupported or unavailable evidence explicitly.

Preserve all original parser/build-only/429 errors. New successful observations supplement history; they do not make the original packet acceptable. The existing foundation verifier still rejects that packet.

stages.objective: Declare one disposable amd64 Linux/engine/profile and a finite execution contract before obtaining a runtime slot.
mandatory_evidence: Bind distribution/kernel/engine/Compose/cgroup/filesystem/data-root/security enforcement, placement, network policy and exact resource limits. SB-02 source preflight alone is not an observed clean-host install.

Freeze complete redacted effective configuration, ordered overlays, generated dummy credentials and credential-safe commitment policy, fixtures, SDK versions, endpoints, commands, timers, cleanup ownership and failure criteria.
Publish resource reservation and require root coordination before any Docker/build/native workload. Add arm64 only after matching actual suite, not manifest presence.

stages.objective: Implement and observe all six existing foundation acceptance tests on a fresh public clone.
mandatory_evidence: Freeze exact registry runner/argv and fixture bindings for public-clone-immutable-linux-build, no-private-source-runtime, reference-image-packet, release-capability-evidence-identity, required-missing-check-refusal and distribution-reproducibility. Current empty commands remain refusals.
Use no private SQL/HBA, retained native volume, workstation path, inherited credential or hidden local artifact. Confirm no secret appears in logs or release assets.

Build twice on independent clean environments using identical pinned inputs. Compare declared reproducible outputs or explicitly identify and constrain nonreproducible fields. Verify release hashes/signatures and package inventory.

Start the original isolated reference with the declared configuration and perform matched SDK operations. Missing startup or native continuity evidence blocks runtime acceptance even if metadata verifies.

stages.objective: Inventory actual installed software and application objects before selecting a patch route.
mandatory_evidence: Distinguish original reference PostgreSQL 17.6.1.136, candidate native lock 17.6.1.166 and legacy postgres:17-alpine. Image tag spelling is not observed server_version_num, package version, extension version or backport provenance.

Capture actual server and pg_dump/psql client versions, immutable image/config identities, binary/package provenance, extension versions, collation/encoding and role/owner/ACL/RLS/custom-schema inventory for every affected environment.

Map dated upstream advisories to actual packages, enabled provider/routing options and lower-trust principals. Record affected, not-affected-with-evidence or unknown for each, never infer safe from an empty search.

Choose in-place compatible patch, separately declared patched bundle, or migration/restore only after compatibility and recoverability review. A patched bar requires explicit amendment and rerun of affected comparisons; never rewrite v0.8.2.

stages.objective: Implement one aggregate complete-contract runner with mandatory named subchecks and independent review.
mandatory_evidence: Freeze executable aggregate manifest before running. Each security case below must produce positive assertions and raw observations. No skips or fake zero-case success.
Use disposable dummy data and principals; lower-trust access denial and unchanged control cases before and after remediation, failure/crash/recovery and secure rollback route.
Preserve upstream service contracts, owners/ACL/RLS/views/custom schema and object bytes. Security patch success cannot substitute for native startup, SDK flow, Cron continuity or fenced recovery.
No production exploitability conclusion follows from version metadata. Source review supports but cannot replace scoped runtime evidence.

stages.objective: Gate G12 with current complete evidence for every claimed slice and profile.
mandatory_evidence: Require current public-release tests claimed-profile-acceptance, all-claimed-slices-current, public-pilot, seven-day-soak, licenses, contributor-setup, vulnerability-reporting and support-windows.
Record pilot and seven-day observation interval, workloads, restarts, errors, recovery points and remediation. Required coverage cannot be narrowed to turn a refusal into success.
Publish licenses/SBOM, dependency scope and vulnerability disposition, contributor instructions, disclosure channel, component/host support windows and upgrade/recovery policy.
Production uses separate production contract and actual independent-host recovery/workload proof. Unit/source/metadata/security-only proofs never close G12 or inherit production.

sb03_security_cases.required_observation: Observed server/client/extension version and verified package/build source for original and selected patch route; vendor patch disposition per relevant advisory.
Inventory encoding/collation and affected index operator classes plus deep-label values; compare indexed and sequential query results after declared remediation.

Owner-approved dummy symmetric and asymmetric legacy-cipher fixtures; correct-key/wrong-key behavior, modern-cipher re-encryption and byte-safe recovery. Production secret/data scan requires separate approval and privacy contract.
NaN and ordinary float fixtures plus index/operator-class inventory; equality/range results agree with control queries after repair.
Recreate non-extension custom operators using the intended non-superuser workflow; reject unauthorized privilege escalation and verify affected restore/branch routes.

Inventory all schemas, owners, ACLs, RLS, security-invoker views, sequences/publications and custom owners; preserve effective application access. Upstream public-only migration is insufficient for arbitrary custom schemas.
Bind actual Auth binary provenance/provider configuration and advisory version range; issuer/nonce/session negative cases with dummy providers and no external victims.
Bind effective Envoy/Kong route configuration; normalized path/header/API-key and stale-key denial for enabled services. Reference gateway is Envoy; a Kong override is an explicit profile.
Before/after Auth login/refresh, Data API isolation/RLS, exact Storage bytes and each enabled Realtime/Functions/Studio/Cron contract with pinned SDK and identical fixture.

Capture coherent DB/object/credential-policy recovery set, rehearse interrupted update and restore on a different isolated host with original host unavailable; stale principals denied and new writes verified.
Dated vendor advisories for every image/package/base/client/extension, verified SBOM/provenance and patch disposition; image digest alone is no signature, source proof or safe configuration.

Missing cases, skipped/empty assertions, stale source/profile/fixtures/time, raw log tampering, unsupported architecture and changed remediation must refuse; verify through actual CLI before claiming acceptance.
